race.comment: MILLIONAIRE LOVER (9) could only manage eighth on debut then improved last start but found a couple better over 1000m at Bairnsdale, beaten half a length after being in the firing line on the bend. Heading the right way and maps ideally, go close. WOOSH (11) was okay first up on similar ground at Wangaratta when fifth. Was in the market there and has upside, should improve here. IRONIC FORTUNE (2) wasn't beaten far fresh at Bendigo in third and that reads well for this, with any natural improvement he should take plenty of beating. LUMINARY MISS (15) resumes having run into a good one on debut at Seymour, she should be better this time around and can figure.
